answer.justification: Activation measurements match the system-prompted profile: layer 1 relative L2 is 0.138 (near the 0.113-0.133 range), it climbs steeply with onset at layer 8, and plateaus at 0.488 at layer 16 and 0.516 at layer 32. The layer-2 spike of 31.2 is at the system-prompted floor (31.7-64.0) and far above quantized (0.8-2.8) or fine-tuned (0.7-6.1). Final cosine 0.844, effective rank 2.83 and direction consistency 0.544 fit this category too. Quantized is ruled out by the plateau and large spike, and fine-tuned by the layer-16 value being well above 0.194 and the onset at 8 with the large spike. Base is ruled out because every value is non-zero.
